description: The -- operation: marker of each statement (#831), shared by packages/cli/src/test/runtime/safety-markers.test.ts and chkit_python/tests/test_safety_markers.py. `operations` has one entry per executable statement, null where the statement has no marker; `legacy` is what releases before #831 read: the n-th marker of the file for the n-th statement.

cases.name: a generated migration: every statement has its marker
cases.sql:
-- chkit-migration-format: v1
-- generated-at: 2026-11-19T00:00:00.000Z
-- operation-count: 3
-- risk-summary: safe=1, caution=2, danger=0

-- operation: create_table key=table:app.t risk=safe
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app.t (
  id UInt64 -- the id
) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id;

-- operation: load_table_data key=table:app.t risk=caution mode=async
-- before-retry: TRUNCATE TABLE app.t
-- Warning: loads every row again
INSERT INTO app.t SELECT number FROM numbers(10);

-- operation: alter_table_modify_column key=table:app.t:column:id risk=caution
-- Warning: does not rewrite stored values
ALTER TABLE app.t MODIFY COLUMN id UInt64 DEFAULT 1;

cases.name: an unmarked statement before an async load keeps its own place
an unmarked statement between marked ones
the marker of a commented-out statement marks nothing
a marker after the last statement marks nothing
a marker that does not parse leaves its statement unmarked
a blank line between the marker and its statement
cases.sql:
-- operation: create_table key=table:app.t risk=safe

CREATE TABLE app.t (id UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id;

cases.name: a before-retry line after the statement belongs to no marker
a before-retry line without a marker
cases.sql:
-- before-retry: TRUNCATE TABLE app.t
INSERT INTO app.t SELECT 1;

cases.name: a before-retry line after a block comment belongs to no marker
a marker inside a block comment or a string is text
a marker after SQL on its line is not a marker
cases.sql:
SELECT 1; -- operation: create_table key=table:app.t risk=safe
SELECT 2;

cases.name: a marker before a statement made only of a comment marks the next statement
the last statement without a semicolon
cases.sql:
SELECT 1;
-- operation: create_table key=table:app.t risk=safe
CREATE TABLE app.t (id UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
-- operation: drop_table key=table:app.t risk=danger
